concepts.title: Concept and Kinds of Social Responsibility

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Concept and Kinds of Social Responsibility' refers to.
questions.a: Social responsibility of business is its obligation to act in ways that serve the interests of society along with its own interests, covering economic, legal, ethical and discretionary responsibilities towards owners, employees, consumers, government and community.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Concept and Kinds of Social Responsibility'.
questions.a: Business uses society's resources, so it owes quality goods, fair prices, safe jobs and clean environment back to its stakeholders.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Concept and Kinds of Social Responsibility' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: Social responsibility (source: kebs106.txt concept of social responsibility section)

concepts.title: Need for Social Responsibility and Its Arguments

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Need for Social Responsibility and Its Arguments' refers to.
questions.a: Business owes its existence to society and uses its resources, public expectations demand responsible conduct, long term self interest and avoidance of government regulation support responsibility, and the arguments against it of profit motive violation, burden on consumers and lack of social skills are outweighed by the reality of social power.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Need for Social Responsibility and Its Arguments'.
questions.a: Reality of social power, public expectations, moral justification and long run self interest together press business towards responsibility.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Need for Social Responsibility and Its Arguments' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: Need for social responsibility (source: kebs106.txt arguments section)

concepts.title: Business Ethics: Elements and Social Responsibility of Environmental Protection

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Business Ethics: Elements and Social Responsibility of Environmental Protection' refers to.
questions.a: Business ethics are the moral principles governing business conduct, based on elements like top management commitment, publication of a code, establishment of compliance mechanism, employee involvement and measuring results, and environmental protection is now a central social responsibility with laws on pollution control.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Business Ethics: Elements and Social Responsibility of Environmental Protection'.
questions.a: Ethical conduct goes beyond law: it asks what is right, and a written code with compliance machinery turns ethics into daily behaviour.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Business Ethics: Elements and Social Responsibility of Environmental Protection' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: Business ethics (source: kebs106.txt business ethics section)
